name: script-cd-moves-only-its-own-list
description: A cd moves the later commands of its own and-or list, and a list sent to the background with & runs in a subshell, so the next list starts in the package's directory again. The script cd api && node server.js & cd web && node client.js runs api/server.js and web/client.js, which are roots, so nothing they export is reported and no command is noted. A file no command names is still reported.
